# Amazon

> > Amazon is a global e-commerce and technology company offering online retail, cloud computing, digital streaming, and artificial intelligence services.

Amazon operates multiple business divisions including retail marketplaces, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Prime membership services, and Whole Foods Market. The company serves millions of customers worldwide with products ranging from groceries to electronics, alongside enterprise cloud solutions.

## Key Topics

- Whole Foods Market
- Prime membership
- Grocery delivery
- Organic groceries
- Weekly sales
- Prepared foods
- Amazon Fresh
- Prime delivery
- Whole Foods Market Kitchens
- Specialty food brands
- Easter catering
- New product launches

- [Whole Foods Market: Shop Groceries & Weekly Sales](https://wfm.amazon.com/): Whole Foods Market homepage for organic groceries, Prime delivery & sales
